opening.argument: The presentation sells paid OneCoin-related packages by bundling education with tokens that can supposedly generate OneCoins through mining. It then claims that token splits double both the tokens and the investment, while upgrades promise additional splits and automatic mining. The package slide displays prices alongside combinations offering four or six splits and automatic mining, showing that these benefits are tied to higher-priced packages. Viewers are urged to contact their inviter or use a signup link, while early membership is presented as an opportunity to benefit. A separate chart projects rising OneCoin values over three years, but labels those figures as dependent on company members' commitment and effort. These are promotional claims tied to token purchase, appreciation, and dividends.
